record.office: Chief Justice, Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia
record.t: Was elected to a full 12-year term beginning Jan. 1, 2025, and is serving her first term as chief justice.
record.q: Appointed in 2022 and elected to a full 12-year term that began Jan. 1, 2025, this will be Justice Bunn’s first time serving as the Court’s chief justice.

record.office: Justice, Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia
record.t: Was appointed to the Supreme Court of Appeals of West Virginia by Gov. Jim Justice on April 6, 2022, and took office April 27, 2022.
record.q: Haley Bunn was appointed to the Supreme Court on April 6, 2022, by Governor Jim Justice, and took office on April 27, 2022.

record.office: Assistant U.S. Attorney, Southern District of West Virginia
record.t: Was selected by the U.S. Department of Justice to serve in an Opioid Fraud and Abuse Detection Unit (2017).
record.q: In 2017, the U.S. Department of Justice selected her as one of twelve prosecutors in the country to serve in an Opioid Fraud and Abuse Detection Unit.
